themes_detail.label: Encampment surge
themes_detail.summary: Homelessness visibility in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway spiked dramatically this week with 3 encampment complaints to 311, a 2300% increase from the 0.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting a sudden emergence or concentration of unsheltered residents in the district.
evidence: 3 encampment complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 8.69)
Represents a 2300% spike in just one week
Highest z-score among all detected anomalies, indicating unprecedented severity
reporting_angles: Ground reporting: locate encampments, interview residents and service providers about what triggered the sudden concentration
City response: why did NYPD/Sanitation not act earlier, and what shelter capacity exists in the Bronx?

themes_detail.label: Street condition collapse
themes_detail.summary: This week Morris Park/Pelham Parkway received 69 street condition complaints, a 321% spike from the 16.4 weekly average, indicating sudden widespread pavement, pothole, or drainage failures affecting resident mobility and safety.
evidence: 69 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 16.4 weekly average (z-score: 4.54)
321% increase from baseline, second-highest spike this week
Aligns with recurring CB budget request for 'streetscape improvements' and 'catch basin cleaning'
reporting_angles: Visual documentation: photograph worst-affected blocks, map complaint clusters
DOT accountability: why is maintenance lagging, and when will repairs begin?

themes_detail.label: Damaged street signs
themes_detail.summary: Three street sign damage complaints filed this week vs. 0.8 weekly average marks a 300% spike (z-score: 5.2), suggesting either a discrete vandalism event or deteriorating infrastructure maintenance in Morris Park/Pelham Parkway.
evidence: 3 street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (z-score: 5.2)
Temporal clustering suggests possible coordinated vandalism or single maintenance failure event
reporting_angles: Was there a vandalism incident or storm event this week that caused the damage?
DOT sign maintenance: how long is the typical repair window?

themes_detail.label: Drug activity reports spike
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints surged to 5 last week compared to 0.5 weekly average—a 900% increase (z-score: 4.5)—indicating either an actual uptick in street-level drug dealing or heightened resident awareness/reporting of existing activity.
evidence: 5 drug activity complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.5)
Sustained concern reflected in community board requests for enhanced park safety and enforcement
reporting_angles: NYPD narcotics unit activity: are arrests increasing, and in which blocks?
Community reaction: have recent shootings or visible dealing prompted more 311 calls?

themes_detail.label: Indoor air quality complaints
themes_detail.summary: Indoor air quality complaints jumped to 7 last week from a 1.6 weekly average—a 331% increase (z-score: 6.27)—suggesting possible mold, HVAC failure, or environmental contamination affecting residential buildings in the district.
evidence: 7 indoor air quality complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.6 weekly average (z-score: 6.27)
Converges with elevated heat/hot water complaints (3411 total over 90 days) and plumbing issues (382 total)
reporting_angles: Building investigation: identify which buildings filed complaints and whether they have known mold or HVAC issues
Tenant health impact: interview residents about respiratory or allergy symptoms coinciding with the spike
